_comment: FIXTURE (vibe-ic#905) — the HOLLOW power-intent premise for the L21-1 rule,
held here instead of being read out of a published IC-level run tree.
The rule needs exactly two things to fire: an L21 whose power_domains[] is
empty, and at least one design-staged hard macro whose OWN LEF types a pin
USE POWER / USE GROUND. Both are supplied by this fixture, so the assertion
no longer depends on run output that landed beside the published cells.
Deliberately synthetic and chip-agnostic: the macro and its pins are named
for what they are, not after any design, foundry, process or product.
